name: Open World
tagline: A desert oasis under a real sky: dunes, two turquoise lakes, palm groves, boulders — with the Tactical weapons in hand
description: The engine's open-world template. OASIS is a 512 m desert biome built entirely from engine data: a sculpted heightfield terrain (sand, damp shore, sandstone escarpment, grass), two Water surfaces that follow the basin, a Foliage layer with 28 kinds of plants and rocks (date palms, quiver trees, desert shrubs, succulents, reeds and grass at the water, boulders, cliffs) scattered by biome rules, a Radiance HDRI sky whose sun lights the scene, warm height fog, SSAO and bloom. You play it with the Tactical Shooter's animated weapons, CoD movement and HUD; the gun RANGE is still in the project as a second scene. Every system is a readable project script and every asset a CC0 download (Poly Haven, Yughues) — the world was authored through the engine's own services and MCP tools, so Claude can reshape it from the editor chat: terrain, foliage, water, sky and fog.
